posts.text:
I don’t mind at all that there are people who don’t get that this is a quote from “Animal House.”

But the assumption that I must be an idiot who doesn’t know anything (and the confident replies to that effect) is everything that is wrong with social media.
The quotation marks might have been a clue that this wasn’t serious.
“Was it over when the Germans bombed Pearl Harbor?”
Well, when you put it like that...
Having an HLR-imposed word limit might have ... helped with that.
Really looking forward to your reaction...
I had some … alternative title ideas along similar lines.
If only I'd had a social media-savvy RA who could've made this happen...
My social media team (i.e., Karen) had some free time this afternoon…
